consequence.statement: This is a reference to release documentation with no operational consequence; operators need not take action based on this entry alone

original.statement: This change is a reference to external documentation (a blog post), not a product change in Argo CD itself.

decision.reason: [ev-01dc0c101cb4] is only a link to an external blog post about the release. It does not describe any product change, failure, rejection or required step. A "none" consequence (informational) is right for this entry by itself. The proposed statement is limited to "this entry alone", so it does not hide the breaking changes that the release documents elsewhere.
